_note: Power outages from public news reporting (scripts/grid-news.mjs, no AI model; owner 2026-11-20: many utilities' own feeds cannot be used, so CyberView reads what news publishers report and cites the publisher). queries run against Bing News (hl = language, gl = country edition; Google News is not read: its robots.txt disallows /rss/); per_run of them each run, rotating, so every query runs every few runs. gdelt_queries run against GDELT. utilities: [name, country, area as shown, lat, lng, names used in the news...]; their area places a report that names the utility but no place. places: [name, country, lat, lng, kind (city or region), other names...]; a name ending in * matches the start of a word (inflected languages). countries: extra names for a country (other languages, demonyms). Everything placed is approximate (the centre of the place named). The owner may change any of this. ambiguous: places whose own name is NOT used as an alias (every other place's own name is, besides its aliases). multi_area_utilities: utilities serving several areas: a report naming only the utility is placed at the country centre; a place it names wins. context_aliases: [place name, short form exactly as written (case kept), context words...]: the short form places a report only when the headline or summary also has one of the context words.
